status: frozen before new applicability audit outputs
additional_evaluation: Six fixed30s blocks and full180s in the already frozen scoring interval; radar-only metrics, no HR scoring
sampling: 100Hz index subsample identical to original calibration (no new filtering); save points for0..max(90,score_end). Not a new antialiased signal representation.
candidate_policy: Save all6 homogeneous eigenpairs per fit, including all finite rejected candidates. Preserve undefined ellipse diagnostics as null+reason for hyperbolae/imaginary conics, never zero error.
numeric_outputs: ellipse semi-axes normalized/native mV and orientation
production_policy: Import immutable fixed solver only for acceptance checks. Diagnostic partial fits and rejected ellipses never replace production calibration. No HR output, band/peak/window change or guard relaxation.

time_exit.support: Unique proper finite ellipse at both intervals, at least6 common10degree angle bins (>=10points each), and each local95percent arc>=180degrees
time_exit.time_dependent_mismatch: Both local fits pass unchanged guards, matched-angle median absolute radius change>=0.10, max cross-fit RMSE penalty>=0.10, and center shift>=0.25 early-radius units or log-shape change>=0.25
time_exit.stable_geometry: On supported arcs, matched-angle change<=0.05, transfer penalty<=0.05, center shift<=0.10 and log-shape change<=0.10
time_exit.otherwise: Inconclusive/mixed; limited arc and changing angular sampling can make parameter changes non-identifiable
time_exit.interpretation: Descriptive diagnostic conventions, not statistical significance, physiological thresholds or new acceptance gates
time_exit.next: Time-dependent evidence => study fixed-model applicability. Stable geometry but high mismatch => investigate model/solver/guard rationale, validate any proposed modification on known phase before real rerun. Mixed => retain uncertainty. Do not change HR rules or visit untouched subjects in this audit.

reference_inputs: No ECG/HR decoded. Existing record timing and intervention markers only; known jump catalogue is separate and never a calibration input.
